items.q: Hello, good afternoon!
My name's Aisha and I'm a first year medical student.
So what's brought you in to hospital today?
So how long have you been feeling short of breath for?
How far can you walk before you get SOB?
can you manage the stiars at home ok?
items.note: typo 'stiars'; 'home' should not pull to living situation

items.q: Is your breathing worse when you lie flat?
how many pilows do you sleep on?
items.note: typo 'pilows'; narrow detail of the orthopnoea fact

items.q: Any PND?
Do you ever wake up in the middle of the night fighting for breath?
That must be really hard, not being able to sleep properly.
items.note: mentions sleep but is an empathy statement, not an orthopnoea question

items.q: Any chest pain or palpitations?
Does your chest feel tight or heavy at all?
Have you had any blackouts?
Have you had a cough at all?
any haemoptysis?
have you been wheezy?
Any fevers or coughing?
items.note: bundled; asks whether there is a cough, not about coughing up blood

items.q: Have you been feeling hot and shivery at all?
Has anyone around you been poorly recently?
Have you noticed your ankles swelling up?
any oedema in ur legs or feet?
Any pain in your calves, or one leg more swollen than the other?
items.note: DVT screen; not the bilateral ankle swelling fact

items.q: Have you put on any weight lately?
How's your appetite been?
Have you been feeling more tired than usual?
Do you have to get up in the night to wee?
items.note: mentions night but is about urination, not PND

items.q: Does it sting when you pee?
items.note: dysuria; 'pee' should not pull to nocturia

items.q: Have you noticed any weakness or pins and needles anywhere?
Have you had any rashes?
Have you been feeling low or down in yourself?
Have you been feeling more thirsty than normal?
Do you bruise easily or bleed for a long time?
items.note: case has nothing on bruising or bleeding tendency

items.q: Do you have any medical conditions I should know about?
Are you diabetic?
Have you ever had an ultrasound of your heart?
Have you ever had any operations?
what meds are you on atm?
Have you been taking all your tablets the way you're supposed to?
Any issues picking up your repeat prescriptions lately?
are you alergic to any medicines?
Is there anything that runs in your family?
smoke?
Do you drink alcohol or take any drugs?
How many units do you drink a week?
Do you use any recreational drugs, like weed?
Have you had more takeaways or crisps than usual lately?
What do you do for work?
Do you live on your own?
What do you get up to in your spare time?
Are you sexually active at the moment?
Have you been abroad recently?
Do you know what your blood type is?
items.note: 'blood' should not pull to the haemoptysis or urinary negatives

items.q: What do you think might be causing this?
Is there anything in particular that's worrying you about all this?
Is there anything else you'd like to mention that I haven't asked about?
What's your favorite TV show?
Thank you so much for answering all my questions, Mr Bennett.
Would it be alright if I examined your heart and lungs now?
Could you lie back on the bed for me, about halfway?
items.note: 'lie back' is a request, not an orthopnoea question
